hypothesis: Personalized promotions increase average 30-day card spending compared with generic promotions.
control: Generic credit-card promotions under the same delivery conditions.
randomization_unit: Individual eligible customer, assigned once before exposure.
observation_period: 30 days after assignment for every customer; confirm this window before launch.
allocation: 1:1 random assignment between treatment and control.
rationale: Random assignment and equal follow-up make the two promotional policies comparable. This is a proposed plan, not a statistical validation.
assumptions: Customers can be treated as independent units without material spillovers.
open_questions: Confirm how overlapping campaigns will be excluded.
limitations: Sample-size planning and independent risk review have not been performed.
